findings.text: blocking: docs/ui/crew.jsx removed flowPackLanes while the parity harness still calls it here and at :515, so tests/test_surface_parity.py fails 11 cases with `flowPackLanes is not defined` (11 failed, EXIT=1, reproduced at 7a83309a5 in this run's log), which the done-when forbids; both harness files are outside this node's fence, so the change cannot land without a scope extension or a served replacement helper.

follow-on: the docstring states that a pointer whose phase is complete sets no state at all, while HELD_RUN_PHASES at reckon/schedule.py:41 contains "complete", so a lone completed pointer reads held; the prose and the set contradict each other.

follow-on: LIVE_RUN_PHASES and HELD_RUN_PHASES re-spell the sets already owned at reckon/sprint_liveness.py:37 and :47 member for member, so the phase vocabulary now lives in two files and the two can drift.

follow-on: the assertion compares item["lane"], stamped by _pack_lanes, against the position of the lane the same packer returned, so both sides move together and a coordinated change leaves the assertion true.

follow-on: the shared-slug case asserts bars["shared"]["nav_key"] == "shared", which a regression to the bare slug also satisfies because the research row never becomes a bar; the discrimination the plan asks for is carried only by the SPA case at :385.
